blurb: DreamChaser offers houseboat rentals on Lake Ouachita featuring 4 to 7 private bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, fully equipped kitchens, gas grill, hot tub, and water slide. Amenities include linens, towels, satellite TV, complimentary captain services, and help with loading and unloading. The company is family-owned since 1989 and serves the Lake Ouachita area and surrounding communities in Arkansas.
